page.overview:
Who is Alexei?

Alexei aka Thunder was one of the metahumans captured by N.O.W.H.E.R.E..

Thunder was taken along with his sister Alya aka Lightning. They were both experimented on activating both their metahuman powers. The twins escaped N.O.W.H.E.R.E.'s facility named the Colony along with Rose Wilson, Ridge and Beast Boy to form the new Ravagers.
